knownSourceRendererEvidence.fact: drawCrawl draws each segment image at the unit center with source-defined motion; transparent image offsets express the assembled shape.
Weapon draw applies mount rotation and recoil before drawing its named region.

limitations: Mask/outline/team-cell atlas pipeline not executed; no failure is inferred from that absence.
Source-level named region presence does not prove a separate picture is needed for nameless effect-only weapons; those are not flagged.
Per-part shape completeness and dynamic registration require visual/source review; no image transforms or runtime tests performed.
